analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Skills Bootcamps are closely linked to priority-sector demand, so local employer need is as important as headline funding.
Area allocations and sector focus can help providers identify where delivery capacity and employer partnerships are most relevant.
Workforce and salary signals provide useful context for which occupational pathways are experiencing the strongest recruitment pressure.
